edits.text: In its present form, 四 has an enclosing 囗 shape around inner 儿-form strokes; this visible structure does not establish the ancient identities or roles of those parts. Its origin remains disputed. One interpretation reads four horizontal marks as counting rods representing four, while another describes a separate graph, 亖, as a direct numeral. A competing proposal treats 四 as a graph depicting breath and later reused to write “four” because the words may have sounded alike; the depicted referent’s original name is unknown. A separate proposal treats 四 as an earlier graph for 泗, depicting nasal discharge, then borrowed for “four”; this account lacks textual attestation. Neither borrowing explanation is established.
